title: Leek and egg pie with a new potato top

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain whole food or staple: potatoes, eggs, leeks, butter, cornflour, milk, spinach and Cheddar.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any Tesco at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a couple of pans and a baking dish, and making a simple white sauce is well within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: Part-boiled sliced potatoes finish in the 25-minute bake, and 2 tbsp cornflour to 500ml milk gives a sauce that holds the leeks, spinach and six eggs for four.

honest_times.reason: Slicing leeks, boiling, making the sauce, peeling eggs and slicing potatoes fits 30 active minutes, and the 25-minute bake matches the last step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the nutmeg and the chives, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm baked pie suits early April, and 800g of new potatoes forms the whole topping, so they are central rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a neighbour could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, cheese, leeks, spinach and potatoes make a filling, balanced family supper.
